bio_text: Xiaoan (Sean) Liu is the founder of Fusion Reality and a researcher at CU Boulder's ATLAS Institute, working at the intersection of spatial computing, mixed reality, and ambient AI. He builds systems that let users interact with real-world objects through AI — rejecting voice-only paradigms in favor of direct manipulation interfaces on smart glasses and AR devices. His open-source project VisionClaw (900+ GitHub stars) and research paper Reality Proxy (UIST 2025) reflect his conviction that the next computing platform is the physical world itself, augmented by AI.
